name: Binance BTC/USDT Kyle lambda price-impact drift
description: Over a rolling window of the last window_trades (N) Binance BTC/USDT trades, kyle_lambda = sum(mid_change_i * signed_volume_i) / sum(signed_volume_i^2): the least-squares slope through the origin of per-trade midpoint change on signed volume, a form chosen for the exact-decimal idiom because it needs only multiply and divide. Each trade's signed_volume_i (trade size times aggressor sign, positive for a buyer-aggressor) pairs with the Binance midpoint change that FOLLOWS it — from the midpoint prevailing at the trade to the next observed Binance midpoint update — so the estimator measures price impact rather than anticipation; trades between two midpoint updates share that same forward change, and a trade with no subsequent midpoint update yet has no completed pair. lambda_drift is the current window's lambda minus the previous disjoint window's lambda. Fewer than 2N completed pairs, or a window whose sum of squared signed volume is zero, is a defined not-ready state and never a division by zero. window_trades defaults to 100. This identity is single-venue by construction: the measurement compares one venue's own trades and book against each other, so it reads only Binance inputs and is ready whenever the Binance book-and-trade join is fresh, independently of the other adopted spot venue. No blended `btc.external.*` variant of this measurement is published: a cross-venue form would have to rule which venue's book prices another venue's trade, and that ruling is deferred pending evidence (ADR 0023 amendment and ADR 0024, both 2026-09-02). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Binance sibling of `btc.coinbase.kyle_lambda_drift@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Binance spot BTCUSDT; at decision time every price-level field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio fields (basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral. Binance inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `binance`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Binance book input is the `btcusdt@depth20@100ms` partial-depth stream: every message is a complete top-20-per-side image at a 100 ms cadence, not a diff, and it carries no venue clock, so `event_time_basis` is `receipt` and `event_time` is the local receipt time. Ordering is the strictly increasing `last_update_id`; a duplicate or lower id is dropped and never applied. The Binance trade input is the `btcusdt@aggTrade` stream: one message is an aggregate of fills at one price on one side at one `trade_time`, with `aggressor_side` derived from `buyer_is_maker`. Aggregation preserves price, side and time, so every formula over signed price-times-size is unchanged; `trade_count` fields count aggregate trades, not individual fills, and the identity states that. quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: every price-denominated field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio, basis-point, base-size and count fields are quote-currency neutral. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD. The venue trades BTC against USDT, so at decision time every price, notional and quote-denominated cost field (kyle_lambda, kyle_lambda_previous, lambda_drift) is converted USDT to USD with the latest USDT/USD reference rate; base-denominated fields (base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios, durations) are unchanged. kyle_lambda, kyle_lambda_previous and lambda_drift are price-impact coefficients in quote per base unit and so convert (E47(e)). The reference is kraken.spot.usdt-usd.ticker, delivered on the dedicated Kraken reference socket (a second reference, coinbase.exchange.usdt-usd.ticker, joins when it lands). quote_currency is the constant "usd". usdt_usd_rate (decimal, eight places, round-half-to-even) and usdt_usd_rate_age_ms are published on every ready decision, and the identity is non-ready with reason usdt_reference_stale when the rate is absent or older than 60000 milliseconds.
